reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
convert aggregate functions into pre-aggregated CTE
optimized_sql:
SELECT
    item.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
    sales_agg.s_state AS s_state,
    GROUPING(sales_agg.s_state) AS g_state,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sales_agg.cnt_q) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(sales_agg.sum_q)::numeric / SUM(sales_agg.cnt_q) END AS agg1,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sales_agg.cnt_list) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(sales_agg.sum_list) / SUM(sales_agg.cnt_list) END AS agg2,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sales_agg.cnt_coupon) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(sales_agg.sum_coupon) / SUM(sales_agg.cnt_coupon) END AS agg3,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sales_agg.cnt_sales) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(sales_agg.sum_sales) / SUM(sales_agg.cnt_sales) END AS agg4
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            store_sales.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk,
            store.s_state AS s_state,
            COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS cnt_q,
            SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS sum_q,
            COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list,
            SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS sum_list,
            COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon,
            SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon,
            COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales,
            SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
        FROM store_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
        INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
        WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1999
          AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M'
          AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
          AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
          AND store.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
        GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk, store.s_state
    ) AS sales_agg
INNER JOIN item ON sales_agg.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (item.i_item_id, sales_agg.s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
